mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% for three consecutive months signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers corporate cost-cutting and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy), a federal funds rate decline below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: New housing starts falling below 600,000 units per month indicates housing sector contraction that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates supply-demand mismatch that reduces corporate profits and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and PAYEMS rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 90), declining industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.02.
